title: The one number you wish you had measured six months earlier
body:
One reply each. The number, why you did not have it, and what it would have changed.

Mine is the **ungrounded baseline** — what the model scores on the eval set with *no retrieved
context at all*.

It costs one run. Without it, every `answer_correct` you report is uninterpretable, because you
cannot tell the system's contribution from the model's prior knowledge. It is the *right by
accident* floor from [The Four
Verdicts](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/60-cheatsheets/frameworks/four-verdicts.md), and I have never once
seen it in a client deck.

### Suggested shape

```text
the number        what it is
why you lacked it nobody asked / seemed obvious / no harness
what it changed   the decision you would have made differently
```

Answers that are a *category* of number rather than a specific one are fine — "anything with an
interval" is a legitimate entry and probably the most common one.
